_doc: Automatic play stats (0.102): when endpoint is set, the game sends this browser's run history (anonymous random player id, no personal data) to the collector Worker in collector/ after every run and once per session; the /analytics/ dashboard reads it back. Empty endpoint = nothing is sent. Setup: collector/README.md. collectorVersion (0.119): the collector/worker.js VERSION this build expects; the dashboard warns when the deployed Worker reports another (it is updated by pasting collector/worker.js into the Cloudflare dashboard). benchmarkPromptRoom (0.133): once a player's best room reaches this, the Great Hall asks them (once, until a result exists) to run the BENCHMARK (ui/benchmark.js). benchmarkPrompt (0.00201): that ask on or off — off for now (the owner's call: back on for testers when needed); the ?debug BENCHMARK button works either way.
